text:
ana: FYI — CFO at Meridian Analytics pushed back, wants final POC consumption numbers and a commitment on monthly cap before exec signoff. They said legal won't sign without cost guardrails.

mike: Understood. What numbers are they asking for specifically? current POC is 3 nodes, 24/7, with burst to 6 for peak.

ana: (typo) — ana: Sorry, typo — they want a committed monthly token quota and a predictable overage rate. Also asked for a sample SOW duration and SLA language.

ravi: Do we have precedent? For similar mid-enterprise POCs we offered a capped usage + burst policy:
```
commit: 3k USD/month
included_tokens: 30M
overage_rate: $0.0008/token
burst_policy: up to 2x for 72 hours, subject to prioritization
```

mike: Those numbers look reasonable. But we need infra confirmation that Dedicated pool can sustain 2x bursts week-of-month without impacting other reserved customers. @lee can you confirm?

lee: I can validate. Quick notes: if we pin them to m6a-dedicated pool we can guarantee throughput. For the 2x burst we need an extra 1 GPU day/week reserved or enable burst from shared spare capacity (no SLA). Which does Sales prefer?

ana: We need SLA-backed burst for CFO to sign. They explicitly called out predictable availability.

olivia: @lee prioritize an answer for SLA-backed burst by EOD. I'm escalating this to the exec sync — CFO said it's blocking procurement and a QBR decision. Also we should surface a short tradeoff doc for pricing vs guaranteed capacity.

carl: From CS side, customer is running a 2-week POC, currently 4M tokens/day peak during query tests. If burst is denied they'll stop stress testing. We need a temporary quota lift for the POC window.

mike: Can we do a temporary quota bump for 14 days while Legal and Sales finalize SOW? That buys time. @sarah any objections?

sarah: Legal needs the proposed SOW language to expedite. I can fast-track once Sales puts in the committed numbers, overage, termination, and an indemnity/PD clause. We can add a clause for data residency/KMS (they asked for Azure EU).

ana: Customer wants KMS + EU data routing. Are those supported in Dedicated?

lee: Yes, Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS and VPC peering in Azure regions EU-North and EU-West. We'll note an extra charge for cross-region egress.

ravi: Action items I'm tracking: 1) @lee confirm SLA-backed burst capacity and cost delta 2) @sarah prepare SOW draft w/ proposed numbers 3) @olivia prepare one-pager for execs on tradeoffs 4) @mike coordinate with infra for temporary quota bump.

mike: I've opened a ticket with infra and tagged deploy-bot for quota changes.

deploy-bot: Quota request received: ticket #INF-8421. Temporary GPU quota bump to 6 nodes for account meridian-001 requested for 2024-06-22 — 2024-07-06. Pending manual approval from eng-infra.

lee: Quick preliminary: SLA-backed burst will require reserving an extra GPU (monthly uplift ~ $6k) or offering a lower-latency prioritized queue with soft guarantees. For exec ask, recommend commit+burst with a 3-month minimum to justify reservation.

olivia: Thanks. @sarah please draft SOW with commit matching lee's recommended uplift so numbers align. I'll loop in our COO for pricing approval if uplift exceeds $5k/mo.

sarah: On it. ETA EOD for a draft. Also need confirmation of KMS endpoint and region from the customer — please collect.

carl: I'll get the customer's infra contact and their KMS endpoint today.

ana: Meridian asked for billing cadence options (monthly vs quarterly invoicing). Can Legal/Finance leave flexibility in SOW?

olivia: We can allow quarterly invoicing but lock pricing per month. Finance pre-approval required — I'll ping finance separately.

ravi: Final ask: can we add an explicit rollback policy if their tests cause cross-tenant performance issues? They worry about impact to other customers.

lee: We'll include a performance isolation clause and monitoring hooks. Also add automatic fallback to a lower-capacity model variant if noisy neighbor detected.

mike: Great. Once we get SOW draft + infra confirmation I'll schedule an exec bridge with Meridian to close.

ana: Thanks team — this is high priority. I flagged as urgent in CRM and told Meridian we'll have a firm proposal within 48 hours.

olivia: Closing loop: if any blocker, ping me directly. I'll join the bridge if needed. :thumbsup:
